overview_description.description:
Patched is an open-source framework to automate code reviews, docs, and patches with AI.

We empower developers to build and deploy AI-assisted workflows that can autonomously complete repetitive, mundane tasks like documentation, code reviews, and security patching.

Patched is the preferred option for privacy-conscious enterprises and engineers that want to leverage the best AI models for their development workflows without compromising security, control, or compliance.

about_short_description.short_description: Patched Codes provides open-source workflow automation for development teams

product.name: Patchwork
product.description: An open-source framework for automating IT and development workflows, enabling tasks like bug fixes, vulnerability patches, documentation updates, and issue triage.

product.name: GenerateREADME
product.description: A Patchwork patchflow that automatically generates README.md documentation files for repository folders based on their contents.

product.name: PRReview
product.description: A Patchwork patchflow that automatically summarizes and comments on pull requests based on code changes.

product.name: DependencyUpgrade
product.description: A Patchwork patchflow that automatically updates vulnerable dependency versions in repositories while mitigating breaking changes.

product.name: Patched GitHub Repo Analyzer
product.description: A tool that analyzes GitHub repositories to identify opportunities for LLM-assisted workflow automation across code, issues, and pull requests.

product.name: GitHub Actions for Patched
product.description: A set of GitHub Actions that integrate Patched's patchflows into CI/CD pipelines for automating documentation generation, PR reviews, vulnerability fixes, and more.
